description: A Java class that provides a user interface component for building Android intents dynamically, allowing users to select actions, flags, and target activities to launch, with optional verification mode.

classes.name: IntentBuilderView
classes.description: A custom FrameLayout view that allows users to configure and build Android Intent objects interactively, including selecting target activities, intent flags, and optional suggestions for conflicting flags, with support for verification mode.

methods.name: IntentBuilderView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view and setting up internal components based on context and mode.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Initializes the user interface components, populates activity options, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: currentIntent
methods.description: Constructs and returns the current Intent object based on user selections.

methods.name: startForResult
methods.description: Determines if the intent should be started for a result based on UI toggle.

methods.name: clearFlags
methods.description: Resets all checkbox selections related to intent flags.

methods.name: selectFlags
methods.description: Selects checkboxes corresponding to the provided list of flag names.

methods.name: selectFlags
methods.description: Overloaded method that selects checkboxes based on a collection of IntentFlag objects.
